title: 2027 Diploma Program (Regular Decision)
level: Secondary-school students (born on or after 1 September 2007)
about: African Leadership Academy is accepting Regular Decision applications for its 2027 pre-university Diploma Program. Applicants must be born on or after 1 September 2007. Applications close on 15 January 2027; decisions follow in April 2027.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for "2027 Diploma Program (Regular Decision)" at African Leadership Academy, Johannesburg, South Africa, application deadline 15 Jan 2027. The background photo shows The Palace of the Lost City, Sun City.
